scenes.description: A person lifts a section of hair, fine separated strands falling freely from the raised hand.
Fine dry sand pours in a narrow continuous stream from relaxed fingers onto a small mound.

scenes.sense: A soft murmur of flowing water
scenes.description: A shallow clear stream flows gently around smooth pebbles and rocks, with fine ripples and no large splashes.
Green leaves on a slender branch move lightly against a blue sky, with delicate curved motion marks.
A hand holds a brush over plain paper bearing a long abstract wavy ink stroke.
